ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.
